title: It's Casual pack
description: It's Casual pack is a collection of mods for those who want to improve the game without losing its classic charm.
body:
## _💠 It's Casual pack – a build for true casuals!_
![sity](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/AjuutBtX/images/fc238f3b54295ad249d0b132f41168842d1a129e.jpeg)

It's Casual pack is made for those who enjoy relaxed Minecraft gameplay without sacrificing quality.  
I’ve picked some of the best mods and resource packs (in my opinion) that enhance the experience while keeping the vanilla charm.  
Perfect for both new and experienced players who want a cozy, beautiful adventure.

🌐 Join our communities:
- Discord: [https://discord.gg/G8N8b77Svx](https://discord.gg/G8N8b77Svx)

⚠ Not passed copyright check:
